angband.role: The game, plain and unmodified: upstream 4.2.6. Built --disable-borg with the main-test frontend, plus our own input hook from patch/. The same commit borg-agent pins as `original`, so runs here and Borg runs are the same game.

strategy-manual.role: Seventeen chapters, ten appendices generated from lib/gamedata, and a copy of the official user manual. Chapter 15 is a machine-oriented distillation that says of itself that its rules are a starting policy to be measured, not truths - which is how a run here must treat them.
